claim_summary: For independent homogeneous bond percolation on the two connected six-vertex cubic graphs, rooted outbreak size on the triangle-free complete bipartite graph strictly first-order stochastically dominates that on the triangular prism for every interior edge retention probability. Their variance difference reverses sign exactly once at a unique algebraic threshold near 0.47924529478.

integrity.literature_status: Relevant full open-access epidemic-clustering study inspected; some closely related studies inspected only as accessible abstracts; independent bibliographic verification remains necessary.
integrity.method: Complete finite open-edge-state enumeration plus exact polynomial identities and a Descartes-rule uniqueness argument.

scientific_limitations: Exact claim applies only to six-node connected cubic contact networks and homogeneous independent edges; it is not a statement about arbitrary degree-controlled networks or empirically measured epidemic populations.
title: Stochastic outbreak dominance with a unique variance reversal between the first two cubic contact networks
